title: 第15章 心如世上青莲色第16章 老宅有灵
content_zh:
;;
不多时，曹蒹葭领着一道熟悉的身影踏入院中。
那人走在曹蒹葭身后，垂眉敛目，一声不吭，一手提剑，一手举着盏烛台。
还真是故人。
谢临川收扇，笑着迎了上去。
鱼吞舟没有猜错，曹蒹葭去找的“奴隶”
，就是张清河。
“开始吧。”
曹蒹葭直截了当道，“你想从哪里开始烧？”
鱼吞舟看了眼张清河，这位面无表情，目不斜视，似乎全当没看到他。
这时，一把纸扇横在了张清河面前，慢慢收回，扇骨轻敲掌心，谢临川语气熟稔的很：
“清河兄，你我也是数年不见的旧识了，不打声招呼？”
看向谢临川后，张清河明显露出了忌惮之色，沉声道：
“你和这家伙为伍，真不怕日后被小镇各家子弟群起而攻之？北原谢家名头再响，在这里也不是无敌的。”
谢临川笑意更甚，纸扇重重敲击掌心，语气淡然道：
“岂不知，这正是在下想要的？”
张清河沉默片刻，低声：“你还是这么……狂妄！”
曹蒹葭不耐蹙眉：“现在是叙旧的时候吗？磨叽什么？”
鱼吞舟适时接过话题：“以水渠为界，先清理各区域的交界处，留出半尺空地隔火，以防火势蔓延，然后一块区域一块区域的焚烧。”
曹蒹葭二话不说，从张清河手中拔剑出鞘，一道寒光锋芒乍起，掠过鱼吞舟的面庞。

少女冷哼一声，按照鱼吞舟指示的范围，开始唰唰割草，效率极高。
待各边界处清理得差不多了，鱼吞舟便开始点火，火星一落，明火升腾，吞噬院中荒草。
谢临川找来了水桶，装满了水，四人各守一方，任由火势起，直到烧到边缘，便会出手阻拦。
整个院子被水渠切割成了十数块，他们一块块烧，虽然慢了些，但可以保证可控。
原本丛生的荒草，在烈火中渐渐化为黑灰色的灰烬。
约莫半个时辰后，最后一块区域的野草也焚烧殆尽，黑烟散去后，鱼吞舟将之前寻来的铲子，递给三人，让他们将草木灰都翻到泥土下面。
曹蒹葭握着铁铲，眉头皱得更紧了。
“这叫烧草留灰，杂草烧成的余烬，同样是一种肥料，生于此方土地，死后也能反哺这块土地，算是另一种落叶归根。”
鱼吞舟语气平和，对曹蒹葭解释道。
曹蒹葭眼底有诧异和怀疑，这些草灰也能用来沤肥？
她侧头，一个目光过去，示意张清河找个东西，装点回去。
content_en:
;;
Not long after, Cao Jianjia led a familiar figure into the courtyard.
The man walked behind Cao Jianjia, with lowered eyebrows and eyes, without saying a word. He held a sword in one hand and a candlestick in the other.
Really old friends.
谢临川收扇，笑着迎了上去。
Yu Tunzhou guessed right, Cao Jianjia was looking for the "slave"
, that is Zhang Qinghe.
"Let's get started."
Cao Jianjia said straightforwardly, "Where do you want to start burning?"
Yu Tunzhou glanced at Zhang Qinghe. The man's face was expressionless and his eyes were fixed, as if he had not seen him at all.
At this time, a paper fan was placed in front of Zhang Qinghe, and he slowly retracted it, tapping the fan bone on his palm. Xie Linchuan spoke in a very familiar tone:
"Brother Qinghe, you and I have not seen each other for several years. Why don't you say hello?"
After looking at Xie Linchuan, Zhang Qinghe showed obvious fear and said solemnly:
"If you work with this guy, are you really afraid that you will be attacked by all the children of the town in the future? No matter how famous the Beiyuan Xie family is, they are not invincible here."
Xie Linchuan's smile became even wider, he tapped the paper fan on his palms and said in a calm tone:
“岂不知，这正是在下想要的？”
Zhang Qinghe was silent for a moment and whispered: "You are still so... arrogant!"
Cao Jianjia frowned impatiently: "Is now the time to reminisce about the past? What are you talking about?"
Yu Tunzhou took over the topic at the right time: "Using the canal as the boundary, first clean up the junction of each area, leaving half a foot of space for fire isolation to prevent the fire from spreading, and then burn one area after another."
Without saying a word, Cao Jianjia pulled out the sword from Zhang Qinghe's hand, and a cold light flashed across Yu Tunzhou's face.
The girl snorted coldly and started mowing the grass according to the range indicated by Yu Tunzhou, which was extremely efficient.
When the borders were almost cleared, the Yutunzhou started to light a fire. As soon as the sparks fell, the open flames rose up and engulfed the grass in the courtyard.
Xie Linchuan found a bucket and filled it with water. The four of them each stood guard and allowed the fire to start until it reached the edge, then they would take action to stop it.
The entire yard was cut into dozens of pieces by water channels, and they burned them piece by piece. Although it was a little slow, it was still controllable.
The originally lush grass gradually turned into black-gray ashes in the fierce fire.
About half an hour later, the weeds in the last area were burned away. After the black smoke dissipated, Yu Tunzhou handed the shovel he had found earlier to the three people and asked them to turn the ashes of the vegetation under the soil.
Cao Jianjia held the shovel and frowned even more tightly.
"This is called burning weeds and leaving ashes. The embers from burned weeds are also a kind of fertilizer. They are born in this land and can feed back to this land after death. It is another kind of fallen leaves returning to their roots."
Yu Tunzhou explained to Cao Jianjia in a calm tone.
There was surprise and doubt in Cao Jianjia's eyes. Can these grass ash be used for fertilization?
She turned her head and glanced over, signaling Zhang Qinghe to find something and decorate it back.
